Hesaplama akışı: sac açılımı = Σ kenarla: Calculation flow: developed width = Σ edges − bend count × (2 × thickness − bend allowance). Unit weight = developed width × length × thickness × 7.85 g/cm³. Galvanizing = 2 × developed width × length / 1,000,000 × 0.6 kg/m². Table total incl. scrap = Σ parts × qty × (1 + scrap/100). Project total = tonnage of all types.
